CustomField.description: Why the last push failed, in words a person can act on - written by WorkItemSyncService when a push fails, cleared when one succeeds or when a new edit is staged. The detail behind it, including the raw response, is in Integration_Log__c. This is what lets a card show Failed with the reason rather than Failed alone. Internal only: on no guest DTO.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Why the last push to the source system failed. Cleared when a push succeeds.
CustomField.label: Sync Error
